functional.statement: The system SHALL ingest and use the actual HC-published Module 1 controlled-vocabulary/enumeration files (submission/activity types, dosage form, route, etc.) keyed to the Module 1 schema version as the source of selectable metadata values, rather than a hand-maintained list, so that values not in HC's controlled vocabulary are rejected (mirroring I08/H08).
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN HC-published CV/enumeration files WHEN ingested THEN selectable metadata values are sourced from them keyed to the schema version
GIVEN a metadata value not present in the ingested CV WHEN validated THEN the system raises an Error mirroring I08/H08
GIVEN an updated CV file set WHEN loaded THEN selectable values update without code changes
functional.rationale: Rules I08/H08 reject metadata values not in HC's controlled vocabulary; sourcing from HC's published, schema-version-keyed CV files (not a hand-maintained list) is required for correctness.
functional.traces_to: GAP: ingest HC-published CV/enumeration files keyed to Module 1 schema version

functional.statement: The system SHALL provide a 'basis' classification on every compliance-related requirement and control — one of HC-mandate, GC-direction, provincial-privacy, PIPEDA, GMP-best-practice, or value-add — so sponsors can scope cost/risk and auditors are not misled about what Health Canada actually requires of a submission-preparation tool.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN any compliance control (residency/Protected B, Annex-11/ALCOA+ e-sig, CSV IQ/OQ/PQ, DR/RPO/RTO, retention) WHEN presented THEN it carries an explicit basis tag from the defined set
GIVEN a control tagged value-add or GC-direction WHEN displayed THEN it is not presented as an HC mandate
GIVEN PIPEDA breach-management controls WHEN tagged THEN they are marked as genuine PIPEDA obligations
functional.rationale: Residency/Protected B, ALCOA+/Annex-11, CSV, DR and retention were all presented as HC-mandated MUSTs, overstating regulatory obligation; an explicit basis field corrects the framing honestly.
functional.traces_to: GAP: distinguish HC-mandated from value-add controls; CORRECTIONS on residency/e-signature/sourcing framing

functional.statement: The system SHALL anchor electronic-signature handling to the HPFB Electronic Signatures Policy and provide a workflow to obtain and record case-by-case Health Canada acceptance of a given e-signature approach (request via hc.cesg-pcde.sc@canada.ca), rather than asserting a self-imposed Part-11/Annex-11 mandate.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN an e-signature approach WHEN configured THEN the system references the HPFB Electronic Signatures Policy as the governing artifact
GIVEN a need for HC acceptance WHEN initiated THEN the system provides a workflow/record to request and capture HC's case-by-case acceptance
GIVEN HC acceptance recorded WHEN a signature gate evaluates THEN the accepted approach is treated as authorized for that sponsor's submissions
functional.rationale: HC accepts e-signatures on submission content case-by-case under the HPFB Electronic Signatures Policy (a permission); the requirements built an Annex-11 control set without anchoring to HC's actual policy.
functional.traces_to: GAP: anchor e-signature handling to HPFB Electronic Signatures Policy (case-by-case acceptance)

functional.statement: The system SHALL detect and block Health-Canada-prohibited non-password security settings on submission files — DRM, IRM, restricted access, and rights-management settings — as a distinct check alongside the encryption/password check (A09), so a transaction with such settings does not pass the portal gate only to fail at HC.
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a file with DRM/IRM/restricted-access/rights-management settings WHEN validated THEN the system blocks it with a security-settings Error distinct from the A09 password/encryption finding
GIVEN a file with no security settings beyond allowed defaults WHEN validated THEN the security-settings check passes
GIVEN a blocked security-settings defect WHEN displayed THEN it is mapped to the exact file and names the offending setting
functional.rationale: HC explicitly prohibits non-password security settings (DRM/IRM/restricted access/rights management); these would fail at HC even if the portal's basic encryption/password gate passes.
functional.traces_to: GAP: detect/block DRM/IRM/restricted-access/rights-management (beyond A09)

functional.statement: The system SHALL implement a validation check mirroring Health Canada rule A02 (file and folder security/readability) that verifies every file and folder in the transaction is readable and free of access-permission restrictions, as a distinct general-category check separate from PDF encryption (A09).
acceptance_criteria: GIVEN a file or folder with restrictive access permissions or unreadable content WHEN validated THEN the system raises an Error mirroring A02
GIVEN all files and folders are readable with no permission restrictions WHEN validated THEN the A02 check passes
GIVEN an A02 defect WHEN displayed THEN it is mapped to the exact file/folder path and distinguished from A09 encryption findings
functional.rationale: A02 is a distinct named HC general-category rule; folder/file permission/readability failures are a validation trigger separate from PDF encryption (A09).
functional.traces_to: GAP: A02 file/folder permission/readability check distinct from A09

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL support pinning all primary data stores, processing, caches, logs, and backups to Canadian cloud regions and preventing cross-border replication of submission/health data WHERE a sponsor contract, applicable provincial health-privacy law, or procurement by/for a Government of Canada body requires it. This in-Canada/Protected B residency is a configurable VALUE-ADD control, not a Health Canada mandate on a sponsor's submission-preparation tool.
nonfunctional.target: When residency is enabled: 100% of in-scope data flows resident in Canada and zero cross-border replication; per-tenant/per-province region pinning supported. Residency is configurable, not a default HC obligation.

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL implement an always-on, tamper-evident, append-only audit trail capturing actor, timestamp with timezone, action, before/after values, and record/version IDs, that no role including super-admin can disable or edit, and SHALL support a QA audit-trail review with named-reviewer documented sign-off.
nonfunctional.target: Audit trail un-disableable by any role; every state-changing action logged with old/new values; QA review sign-off recorded

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL implement electronic signatures that re-authenticate the signer at the point of signing, bind signer identity, timestamp and meaning to the signed artifact, use unique per-user credentials with no shared accounts, and prevent signature repudiation and reuse. HC accepts e-signatures on submission content case-by-case under the HPFB Electronic Signatures Policy; this control set is a VALUE-ADD/best-practice implementation, not a Health-Canada-mandated Part-11/Annex-11 requirement.
nonfunctional.target: Re-auth at signing; identity+time+meaning bound to artifact; non-repudiation enforced; no shared credentials; approach acceptable to HC under the HPFB Electronic Signatures Policy

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL support ALCOA+ data-integrity practices over submission records — Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate, Complete, Consistent, Enduring, Available — retaining originals without overwrite. ALCOA+/Annex-11/CSV apply to GMP/GxP source records and inspected establishments; for a sponsor's eCTD assembly tool these are a VALUE-ADD/GMP-best-practice control, not a Health Canada mandate.
nonfunctional.target: Originals retained, no overwrite; records complete and enduring; ALCOA+ applied as best practice where the sponsor's GxP posture warrants

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL capture express consent for sensitive (health/regulatory submission) personal data with retained consent records, and SHALL support data-subject access and correction handling under PIPEDA as the baseline, with a configurable provincial overlay (e.g. AB/BC/QC PIPA, Ontario PHIPA) where activity is wholly intra-provincial or personal health information is handled.
nonfunctional.target: Express-consent capture with audit-able consent records; access/correction handling available; PIPEDA default with configurable provincial overlay

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL provide a breach-management subsystem that logs every breach of security safeguards in an immutable store retained at least 24 months, supports real-risk-of-significant-harm (RROSH) assessment, and produces OPC report output mapped to the PIPEDA breach report form fields.
nonfunctional.target: Every breach logged immutably; >=24-month retention; RROSH assessment + OPC report generation supported

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL apply defense-in-depth security: TLS encryption in transit, encryption at rest with key management (in-region where residency is enabled), multi-factor authentication, granular access logging feeding the audit trail, and breach-detection monitoring sufficient to determine 'as soon as feasible' that a breach occurred.
nonfunctional.target: TLS in transit; encryption at rest with appropriate KMS; MFA enforced; monitoring drives timely breach detection

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL surface continuous (inline) validation feedback during authoring with low enough latency that defects appear within the active editing session rather than only at a terminal gate.
nonfunctional.target: Inline validation feedback for an edited node within a few seconds of the change under normal load

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL handle large eCTD packages (up to the 10 GB CESG ceiling) for assembly, checksum computation, backbone generation, and transmission without data loss or corruption.
nonfunctional.target: Reliable processing of packages up to 10 GB; checksum re-verification passes 100% for unmodified files

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL be highly available so that authoring, validation, and transmission-status tracking remain accessible, and SHALL durably persist all dossier content, sequences, acknowledgements, and audit records against loss.
nonfunctional.target: High service availability with durable, backed-up storage of all dossiers, sequences, acknowledgements and audit records

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL provide an accessible, low-training guided web UI that requires no scripting to operate the authoring, validation, lifecycle, and transmission workflows.
nonfunctional.target: Guided web workflows usable by an RA Associate without scripting; meets recognized web accessibility standards

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL maintain a separate FDA ESG NextGen Test (pre-production) configuration path, isolated from Production credentials and data, to complete the mandatory test round-trip before any production transmission.
nonfunctional.target: Distinct Test vs Production ESG NextGen configs; Production transmission gated on a successful Test round-trip

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL keep regulatory reference data (validation ruleset versions, CA Module 1 Schema v2.2 / ICH DTD 3.2.2 versions, HC-published controlled vocabularies, fee/CPI-and-2% escalation tables, service standards, Module 1 placement table, REP template versions and stylesheet, management-of-drug-submissions guidance edition 2025-10-01) updatable as configuration data without requiring a code release.
nonfunctional.target: Annual HC updates (rules, schema/DTD, CVs, fees, standards, placement, REP templates, guidance edition) applied via data/config changes with zero code redeploys

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL ensure deterministic, reproducible backbone and checksum generation so that identical content produces byte-identical index.xml, ca-regional.xml, and MD5 outputs across runs and environments.
nonfunctional.target: Byte-identical backbone/checksum output for identical content inputs

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL enforce hard tenant data segregation at the storage and access layers so that no query, export, or cache path can return one sponsor org's data to another.
nonfunctional.target: Zero cross-tenant data exposure across all access, query, export, and cache paths

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL define and meet documented availability, recovery point (RPO) and recovery time (RTO) objectives for all submission, sequence, acknowledgement, audit, and signature data, with periodic restore-tested backups; backups and failover SHALL be confined to in-Canada regions WHERE residency is enabled by sponsor contract/provincial law (a configurable value-add, not an HC mandate).
nonfunctional.target: Documented RPO/RTO met in DR tests; periodic tested restoration with integrity verification; in-Canada confinement applied when residency is enabled

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL apply graceful degradation and integrity-preserving error handling so that failures in external dependencies (FDA ESG, REP ID issuance, acknowledgement ingestion, schema validators) never corrupt, partially write, or silently discard dossier/sequence state, and every such failure is logged to the audit trail.
nonfunctional.target: Zero partial-write/state-corruption on external-dependency failure; all failures audit-logged with retry/resume offered

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL enforce configurable data-retention schedules and legal-hold for all regulated records (submissions, sequences, acknowledgements, audit trails, signature manifests) meeting or exceeding the genuine PIPEDA breach-record minimum (>=24 months) and any sponsor-contracted/provincial period, preventing deletion within retention or under hold and logging all disposition events. Retention beyond the PIPEDA minimum is a configurable value-add/contractual control.
nonfunctional.target: No deletion within retention window or under legal hold; all disposition events immutably logged; retention periods configurable as data; PIPEDA >=24-month breach-record minimum enforced

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL serialize and isolate concurrent operations so that simultaneous multi-user authoring and sequence creation within a dossier cannot produce lost updates, duplicate sequence numbers, or inconsistent backbones, under expected concurrent-user load.
nonfunctional.target: Zero lost updates or duplicate sequence-number assignments under concurrent multi-user load

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHOULD apply documented computerized-system validation (IQ/OQ/PQ) and formal change control such that production code or configuration changes affecting backbone generation, validation rules, checksums, or e-signatures are validated, version-controlled, and traceable to an approved change record before release. CSV/Annex-11 change control is a VALUE-ADD/GMP-best-practice posture, not a Health Canada mandate on a submission-preparation tool.
nonfunctional.target: GxP-impacting changes covered by an approved, traceable change record with IQ/OQ/PQ evidence before production, applied as best practice

nonfunctional.statement: The system SHALL provide a Test/pre-production environment that uses synthetic or de-identified data and is isolated from Production submission/health data, so that ESG test round-trips, ruleset upgrades, and feature validation never expose or commingle real production data (including any Protected B data where residency/classification is enabled).
nonfunctional.target: No real production/Protected B data in non-production; full logical and credential isolation between Test and Production

changelog.change: Replaced the drug Dossier ID validator from ^m[0-9]{6}$ to a prefix-by-type 6-or-7-digit pattern (^[a-z][0-9]{6,7}$) defaulting an ANDS to prefix 'e'; inverted the 8-week rule to a MAXIMUM (warn when requested MORE than 8 weeks ahead, no gate within 8 weeks); added existing-dossier reuse + DSTS-IA lookup path; expanded request branches to include pharmaceutical/biologic clinical-trial and Master File forms.
changelog.reason: 'm' is the medical-device convention; ANDS pharma/biologic eCTD IDs use 'e' with 6-7 digits by activity type. HC's 8-week rule means do not request too early. Most ANDS work is follow-up sequences reusing an existing dossier. HC publishes separate request forms incl. clinical-trial and Master File.

changelog.change: Reworked the CS-BE/BE path: CS-BE electronic copy placed in Module 1.6, full study reports in Module 5.3.1.2, NO 2.7.1 generated when 2.4-2.7 are suppressed; branched Cmax acceptance (point-estimate 80.0-125.0% pre-M13A/non-IR vs full 90% CI 80.00-125.00% under ICH M13A eff 2025-12-27); added a draft-status flag for the CS-BE and comparative-BA guidance.
changelog.reason: Emitting 2.7.1 while suppressing 2.4-2.7 was internally contradictory; HC mandates the CS-BE electronic copy in Module 1.6; Cmax is a versioned moving target under ICH M13A; both guidance docs remain DRAFT (2004-05-18).

changelog.change: Confirmed no 'Form V' reference exists anywhere in the requirement set; none introduced. CS-BE is described as superseding the PCERT bioequivalence module, not 'Form V'.
changelog.reason: 'Form V' is not a Health Canada term (zero hits in HC guidance); it is fabricated/non-Canadian terminology.

changelog.change: Reclassified Company ID from a hardcoded 5-digit numeric format to an HC-assigned opaque token validated loosely (alphanumeric permitted, e.g. K18276).
changelog.reason: The only concrete sample token is 6-char alphanumeric; a 5-digit-numeric validator would reject HC's own IDs.

changelog.change: Specified that drug ANDS RT/PI metadata lands in m1/ca/ca-regional.xml and scoped the AI template + 1.04/1.05 folder placement to the medical-device/IMDRF path only; pinned current template versions CO v5.0.0 (2025-06-03), RT v5.1.0 (2025-09-10), PI 2024-02-12.
changelog.reason: The AI template and 1.04/1.05 placement are device/IMDRF ToC, not drug eCTD; REP template versions were stale (jumped to the 5.x generation in 2025).

changelog.change: Stated the cover letter is sponsor-AUTHORED and placed under the m1-0-1-cover-letter slot (heading 1.0); HC provides only the slot, no fillable cover-letter template; the portal generates it from its own template and auto-populates the Dossier ID.
changelog.reason: The prior wording implied an HC fillable cover-letter form, which does not exist.

changelog.change: Changed the ANDS on-time KPI from 90% to HC's 100% on-time-to-first-decision commitment (Division 1 & 8); retained 90% only for tracked Notifiable Changes/CTAs.
changelog.reason: HC's published target for NDS/ANDS/SNDS/SANDS is 100%; 90% applies to other classes.

changelog.change: Refreshed the ANDS comparative-studies fee seed to $70,750 (FY2025-26) and $71,953 (FY2026-27), demoted $53,836 to a historical CPI-anchor seed only, and modeled per-grouping escalation (CPI Fee=A+(AxB) for most, fixed 2% ministerial rate for the DMF/CPP/CSP/Dealer's-Licence subset).
changelog.reason: $53,836 is the FY2020-21 base (~24% low); escalation is not a single global CPI rate — a defined subset escalates at a fixed 2%.

changelog.change: Keyed the per-DIN annual Right-to-Sell fee by drug type (prescription/non-prescription/disinfectant/biocide amounts for FY2025-26 and FY2026-27) and pinned the statutory October 1 due date.
changelog.reason: The fee varies by drug type and is due Oct 1; both were previously omitted.

changelog.change: Relabeled the acknowledgement chain to HC's three actual artifacts (MDN / FDA Acknowledgement / HC Acknowledgement Receipt), noted MDN IS ACK1 for AS2 under NextGen, targeted FDA ESG NextGen (Apr 2025), and made the Core ID the stored correlation key for reconciliation across gateway and media paths.
changelog.reason: The 'MDN != ACK1' framing conflated two numbering schemes; the integration was implicitly against legacy ESG; no Core ID correlation key was captured.

changelog.change: Targeted FDA ESG NextGen explicitly and pinned the ESG environment version; kept WebTrader/AS2, X.509 cert, HC-recipient, and mandatory test-before-production.
changelog.reason: ESG was modernized to NextGen in April 2025; the persistent flows remain but the portal, API surface, and ACK model are NextGen.

changelog.change: Reframed the >10 GB path from a hard block to 'route to physical media', matching HC's 'should continue to be submitted on media'.
changelog.reason: HC phrases over-limit handling as a residual path, not an absolute prohibition.

changelog.change: Confirmed A03a (Warn 150-200MB) / A03b (Error >=200MB) as real HC rules (not tool-config) and confirmed HC's two-tier Error/Warning model (not critical/major/minor); noted ~90 rule count is approximate.
changelog.reason: Verification confirmed the size rules are published HC rules and the severity model is two-tier; rule count is unverified.

changelog.change: Pinned the real Canadian Module 1 Schema v2.2 XSD (2012-07-06) and ICH eCTD v3.2.2 DTD as first-class version-pinned reference data; required util/ to carry the HC-published DTD+XSL and index.xml to validate against the DTD; resolved the root-element name from the actual XSD rather than asserted prose.
changelog.reason: The schema/DTD can rev independently of the validation ruleset; the dossier was internally inconsistent on the ca-regional.xml root element; util/ DTD/XSL were under-specified.

changelog.change: Pinned the management-of-drug-submissions guidance to the 2025-10-01 edition and added it (with schema/DTD, CVs, REP templates/stylesheet) to the version-transition handling.
changelog.reason: The guidance was re-issued effective 2025-10-01 and was not pinned.

changelog.change: Changed withdrawal status notation to the hyphenated HC acronyms NOD-W and NON-W.
changelog.reason: HC's exact terminology is NOD-W / NON-W with a hyphen.

changelog.change: Made the NOD/NON Inactive window type-dependent (Inactive-45 vs Inactive-90 derived from submission/application type) instead of hardcoding Inactive-45.
changelog.reason: HC sets Inactive-45 or Inactive-90 on NOD/NON depending on submission type.

changelog.change: Made the clarifax 2-15 day tiers overridable defaults adjustable per HC-agreed window (e.g. 2 days clinical-trial screening, 5 days multi-clarifax Division 1) rather than fixed 5/10/15.
changelog.reason: HC states the tiers are guidelines that can be adjusted longer or shorter.

changelog.change: Labeled the eCTD v4.0 voluntary/mandatory dates as industry-roadmap estimates, not HC-fixed deadlines.
changelog.reason: The HC draft TIG dates from June 2019 and its original timeline has lapsed; no binding HC date exists as of 2026-06.

changelog.change: Reclassified in-Canada/Protected B residency as a configurable VALUE-ADD control (hc_mandated=false), enabled only where a sponsor contract/provincial law/GC procurement requires it; dropped the '100% Protected B data flows resident in Canada' HC-compliance framing.
changelog.reason: The GC Direction for Electronic Data Residency binds GC departments, not a private sponsor's SaaS; HC imposes no residency/Protected B classification on a submission-prep tool.

changelog.change: Reclassified Annex-11/ALCOA+ e-signature, CSV (IQ/OQ/PQ), and the audit/signature-manifest controls as value-add/GMP-best-practice (hc_mandated=false); anchored e-signatures to the HPFB Electronic Signatures Policy (case-by-case HC acceptance); kept only no-encryption/passwords, case-by-case e-signatures, and PIPEDA breach handling as honest descriptions of what HC actually requires.
changelog.reason: ALCOA+/Annex-11/CSV apply to GMP/GxP source records and inspected establishments, not a sponsor's eCTD assembly tool; HC accepts e-signatures case-by-case under the HPFB policy (a permission, not a mandate).

changelog.change: Kept PIPEDA breach-management (RROSH, OPC, >=24-month retention) as genuine obligations but made PIPEDA the baseline with a configurable provincial overlay (AB/BC/QC PIPA, Ontario PHIPA).
changelog.reason: PIPEDA is not exclusive; substantially-similar provincial law or provincial health-privacy law may govern; ANDS content has limited PHI.

changelog.change: Added a QOS-CE (Module 2.3) generation/fill/validation requirement parallel to the CS-BE handling.
changelog.reason: new_gap: Module 3 + 2.3 QOS-CE is mandatory for an ANDS; nothing made the portal generate/validate the QOS-CE template.

changelog.change: Added detection of missed service standards with surfacing/triggering of the statutory 25% fee credit (SOR/2019-124).
changelog.reason: new_gap + on-time-KPI correction: HC credits 25% of the fee paid on a missed standard; absent before.

changelog.change: Added a requirement to version the BE acceptance ruleset by submission date + dosage-form class and branch Cmax per ICH M13A.
changelog.reason: new_gap: ICH M13A (eff 2025-12-27) changes Cmax from point-estimate to full 90% CI for IR solid oral; a single hardcoded rule misvalidates.

changelog.change: Added a dedicated STF (Study Tagging File) generation/validation requirement for transactions with study data.
changelog.reason: new_gap: STF is its own HC validation category; required wherever Module 4/5 study data (incl. Module 5 BE reports) appears.

changelog.change: Added bundling/version-tracking of the HC REP XML stylesheet (2025-09-10) and rendering REP XML through it for human review.
changelog.reason: new_gap: HC ships XSL stylesheets to render REP XML; needed to preview what HC will display (supports REQ-024).

changelog.change: Added ingestion/use of HC-published Module 1 controlled-vocabulary/enumeration files keyed to the schema version (not a hand-maintained list).
changelog.reason: new_gap: rules I08/H08 reject values not in HC's controlled vocabulary; must source from HC's published CV files.

changelog.change: Added a 'basis' classification per compliance control (HC-mandate | GC-direction | provincial-privacy | PIPEDA | GMP-best-practice | value-add).
changelog.reason: new_gap: residency/Annex-11/CSV/DR/retention were all presented as HC MUSTs, overstating obligation; honest basis tagging required.

changelog.change: Added a requirement to anchor e-signature handling to the HPFB Electronic Signatures Policy with a workflow to obtain/record HC case-by-case acceptance.
changelog.reason: new_gap: requirements built an Annex-11 control set without anchoring to HC's actual case-by-case e-signature policy.

changelog.change: Added detection/blocking of HC-prohibited non-password security settings (DRM/IRM/restricted-access/rights-management) distinct from A09.
changelog.reason: new_gap: HC explicitly prohibits these; a file could pass the portal's encryption gate yet fail at HC.

changelog.change: Added a validation check mirroring HC rule A02 (file/folder security/readability) distinct from PDF encryption (A09).
changelog.reason: new_gap: A02 is a distinct named general-category rule; permission/readability failures are a separate validation trigger.

changelog.change: Added explicit citation that the one-transaction-at-a-time-per-dossier rule is confirmed by the live CESG FAQ (await HC ack before sending the next sequence; out-of-order = A07).
changelog.reason: Closes the sourcing gap the first audit raised; the rule is well-founded.

changelog.change: Added an hc_mandated boolean to every non-functional requirement, set true only for NFR-012 (FDA ESG test-before-production, a genuine onboarding prerequisite) and false for all others, reflecting honest HC-obligation scoping.
changelog.reason: Verification required distinguishing real HC obligations from value-add controls; only the FDA ESG test round-trip gate is a true external mandate.

removed.reason: No requirements were deleted. All 60 functional and 21 non-functional requirements were preserved (corrected in place where a correction touched them) and 10 new functional requirements (REQ-061 through REQ-070) were added from the 17 new_gaps. The remaining new_gaps were folded into existing requirements rather than spawned as standalone items: CS-BE Module 1.6 placement and the ICH M13A Cmax branch were absorbed into REQ-008 and also captured as the dedicated REQ-063; the existing-dossier/DSTS-IA path and additional dossier-ID request branches were absorbed into REQ-002; the schema v2.2 / ICH DTD 3.2.2 version-pinning was absorbed into REQ-014/REQ-040 and REQ-066; the Core ID correlation key was absorbed into REQ-028/REQ-029/REQ-046/REQ-058; FDA ESG NextGen targeting was absorbed into REQ-003/REQ-028/REQ-046; and the value-add/HC-mandate basis distinction was both added as REQ-067 and applied via the hc_mandated flag across all NFRs. 'Form V' required no removal because it never appeared in the requirement set (it was a dossier-only error).
